name: City Council Budget Workshop
minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council Budget Workshop

  June 15, 2011

A Budget Workshop of the City Council of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to
order by Mayor Leckness at 6:02 p.m., on June 15, 2011, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo,
California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on June 10, 2011, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

Present:  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Reardon
  Council Member Schlicht
  Mayor Pro Tem Ury
  Mayor Leckness

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  Irwin B. Bornstein, Assistant City Manager/Director of Admin. Services
  Michael Solorza, Budget and Research Manager
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Kelley

INVOCATION: Mayor Pro Tem Ury

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Larry Gilbert, M.V.: expressed concern that there is nothing in the budget related to the
Community Development Agency, yet the city borrows from and repays loans to that agency.

City Council Workshop Minutes  1  June 15, 2011
 Mr. Gilbert also asked why the Capital Improvement Program listing does not account for the
projects that are funded and those that are not.

BUDGET WORKSHOP

1.  Review of 2011-13 Proposed Budget

  City Manager Dennis Wilberg presented an overview of the 2011-13 proposed budget.

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Administrative Services Irwin Bornstein outlined
  staff’s process for creating a priority-based budget.

  Michael Solorza, Budget and Research Manger, provided highlights of the proposed two-
  year budget including estimated revenue and operating expenditures.

  The City’s department directors outlined their budget areas.

  By consensus, the City Council directed that the word "explore" be changed to
  "complete" for objective #3 under Current Planning Expenditures (page 141.)

  Motion made by Mayor Leckness, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, to direct staff to add
  an objective to the Economic Development budget (page 89) to investigate opportunities
  for the establishment of a Mission Viejo Chamber of Commerce.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  Motion made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Reardon, to
  direct staff to change the word “implement” to “support” in objective #1 under Economic
  Development expenditures (page 89.)

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

City Council Workshop Minutes  2  June 15, 2011
   Motion made by Council Member Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Reardon, to
  remove objective # 1 on page 175 regarding the implementation of voluntary public art
  projects.

  On roll call, said motion failed by the following vote:

  AYES:  Reardon and Schlicht
  NOES:  Kelley, Leckness, and Ury
  ABSENT: None

RECESS

At the hour of 8:25 p.m., Mayor Leckness declared a recess. The City Council reconvened at
8:36 p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

2.  Review of Existing Capital Improvement Programs

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Administrative Services Irwin Bornstein outlined the
  Capital Improvement Program list.

  Motion made by Mayor Leckness, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, to authorize
  expenditure of up to $2,000 for production of a two-minute video for submission to the
  Petsafe Bark for your Park contest.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, and Ury
  NOES:  Schlicht
  ABSENT: None

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 10:07 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this
session, Mayor Leckness adjourned the meeting to Monday, June 20, 2011, at 5:00 p.m.

__________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of July 5, 2011

City Council Workshop Minutes  3  June 15, 2011
